spans.s:
BRUISE (v. i.):
I To injure: q. v.
II To
crush: q. v.
III To box: q. v.

BRUIT:
I Subs.: v. Report, rumour.
II
Verb: v. To report, rumour.

BRUSH (vt.):
I To take the dirt of:
(1)
मार्ष्टि (मृज्, c. 2.);
(2) शोधयति (c. of शुध्)
II To touch gently: घर्षति (घृष्, c. l.).
III To b. off or away: निष्कासयति (c. of
कस्): v. To remove.
IV To b. up: v. To
furnish.

BRUTAL:
(1) नृशंसः (सा, सं);
(2) क्रूरः (रा, रं):
v. Cruel, savage.

BRUTALITY:
(1) नृशंसता
(2) क्रौर्यम्: v. Cruelty,
inhumanity.

BRUTE (subs.):
I A beast: q. v.: पशुः
II
A brutal man:
(1) पशुः;
(2) पिशाचः
(=fiend). Ph.
human b.
नृपशुः; पुरुषपशुः,
etc.

BRUTE (adj.):
I Irrational: q. v.
II Un-
-civilised: q. v. Ph.
by mere b. force
*केवलं
 पशुसाधारणेन बलेन।
